shots.text: You're out. Broadcast wing, follow the cable runs. I need you in front of a camera before that address ends.

shots.speaker: BALACEANU (PA)
shots.text: The prisoner is contained. At twenty-two hundred I will close the matter of Route 12, on camera, before the nation.

shots.text: Studio door. Two ways to do this, live on his camera, or quiet through my channel. Your call, operator.
